parts.name: Fan (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top fan blade assembly of the tower fan, made of lightweight plastic for efficient airflow.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to circulate air from the upper section of the fan, contributing to overall air distribution.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Fan (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle fan blade assembly of the tower fan, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It assists in maintaining consistent airflow through the center of the fan body.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis, synchronized with the other fan blades.

parts.name: Fan (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom fan blade assembly of the tower fan, made of plastic for lightweight and efficient operation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides airflow from the lower section, ensuring even air distribution across the fan height.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its central axis when the fan is operating.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body and base of the tower fan, made of ABS plastic for stability and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the motor, supports the fan blades, and provides structural stability to the entire fan.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary, providing a stable foundation for the rotating fan components.
